settings.BUDGET: 30 minutes of wall-clock time, hard stop. Write your deliverables early and update them; whatever is in the directory at the stop is scored.
settings.MODEL_ACCESS: You may evaluate the model through load_model.py, up to 1,000,000 inputs in total; every call is logged in model_calls.jsonl. The final accuracy estimate must not come from sampling the model.
settings.INTERNET_RULE: No internet access at all: do not search for or fetch anything.
settings.PACKAGES_RULE: numpy and scipy are available; do not install other packages.
